answer: Starve sybils by metering influence instead of counting heads. Give each verified kernel of identity a fixed lantern of throughput per interval, a hard cap on the reward or weight it can draw, so creating ten thousand clones only splits one dim light ten thousand ways rather than multiplying it. No island of fake accounts can brighten itself through sheer cloning, because the total budget is bounded by scarce verified entry, not by population. Spam becomes self-defeating.
